name: Delaware Division of Corporations (franchise / LLC tax lookup)

prepare.description: Open the franchise tax login page (reusing an existing icis.corp.delaware.gov tab), type the file number, and export the CAPTCHA image as a PNG data URL for the agent to show the human. Never solves the CAPTCHA.

fileNumber.description: Delaware entity file number, digits only

returns.description: {targetId, captchaPng} where captchaPng is a data:image/png;base64 URL; or {stop} when the form or image is missing

submit.description: Type the human-read CAPTCHA, click Continue, wait for the postback, and parse the tax table. Returns {stop:"captcha-rejected"} when the login page comes back, {stop:"unknown-page"} for any other page.

captcha.description: the characters the human read off the image

returns.description: {fileNumber, name, taxYear, rows:[{year, tax, penalty, interest, credit, due}], total, url} or {stop, text}
